answer: Each key holds a bond of 1 that falls to 0 after 6 idle epochs, so parked fakes die without restocking. Refreshing is just normal work for one identity. N votes mean N x 1 repaid every 6 epochs or those keys vanish. Expiry is visible after ember. An expired bond cannot join jurors on the lotus, and honest upkeep stays 1 rather than N through the nectar.
